result.description:
Salary: $67,510 to $72,000
Location: Darwin / Batchelor, NT

About Us:
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the Employer:
We are supporting a reliable cleaning services business (ABN 19 104 515 123) based in Darwin and surrounding areas, operating across commercial, residential, hospitality, aged care, and Airbnb cleaning. The business is known for quality service, attention to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction. With a growing team and service locations across multiple sites, they are seeking a General Clerk to support daily administration, customer enquiries, scheduling assistance, records management, data entry, filing, and general office support.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain business records, including customer details, bookings, invoices, and service documentation.
- Handle incoming communications (emails, calls, messages) and respond to customer enquiries regarding bookings and services.
- Enter and update data in systems and spreadsheets, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
- Assist with preparing routine reports such as schedules, service records, attendance, and stock usage.
- Maintain records of cleaning equipment and supplies issued to staff.
- Support document management, including scanning, filing, and organising office and compliance paperwork.
- Assist with rostering and scheduling cleaning staff across various sites.
- Provide accurate information to customers and site contacts about services and bookings.
- Perform general receptionist duties, including answering calls and directing enquiries.
- Support stock control by tracking usage and assisting with ordering.
- Assist management with general administrative tasks to support daily operations.

Selection Criteria
- Previous clerical, administration, receptionist, customer service, or office support experience.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
- Good computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, calendars, data entry, and document management.
- Clear and professional communication skills when dealing with customers, staff, suppliers, and site contacts.
- Ability to organise tasks, follow instructions, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities.
- Ability to handle confidential business, client, and staff information appropriately.
- Willingness to work in a busy service-based business supporting cleaning teams across multiple sites.
- Understanding of workplace health and safety administration, stock records, or service scheduling will be highly regarded.

Required Experience and Qualifications
- AQF Certificate II or III in Business, Administration, Clerical Services, or a related field is preferred.
- At least one year of relevant clerical, administrative, receptionist, or office support experience
- Experience in cleaning, facilities, hospitality, accommodation, aged care, or other service-based industries will be highly regarded.
- Full working rights in Australia are required.

How to Apply
We are looking for a reliable, organised, and detail-oriented General Clerk to join us and help support the smooth day-to-day administration of our cleaning services business.

To apply, please submit the following:
Resume outlining your work experience and references.
A short cover letter of no more than 300 words explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork. Please use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result.
- A written response of no more than 600 words describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the General Clerk role. Please structure your example or examples using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a reliable and growing cleaning services business that values quality, care, safety, and customer satisfaction, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Phone calls and walk-in applications will not be accepted.

Applications close: 04 August 2026

FULL TIME 38 HOURS PER WEEK

MINIMUM 4 WEEKS ANNUAL LEAVE

SALARY PLUS SUPER

$75K PA - $85K PA plus super

BOZMAC PTY LTD, also known as Bozmac Towing Equipment, is looking for a Metal Fabricator to support their operations.

Bozmac is an Australian-owned manufacturer specializing in high-performance towing and recovery equipment, including tilt slide bodies, truck packages, rotators, and towing accessories designed for professional operators across Australia and the South Pacific. Known as the “Tilt Slide Specialists,” the company combines industry experience, innovative engineering, and rigorous testing to deliver durable, reliable, and safe towing solutions built for demanding recovery operations. Based in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Bozmac is recognized for producing functional, heavy-duty equipment backed by quality craftsmanship and a strong reputation within the towing industry. 

To be considered for the role, you need to have a relevant industry qualification or at least 1-2 years' experience in a similar position.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

-Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans and technical specifications to determine manufacturing requirements.
-Select, measure, prepare and mark out steel, aluminium and other metal materials for fabrication.
-Cut, shape, bend and form metal sections using hand tools, power tools and fabrication machinery.
-Fabricate structural components, truck bodies, chassis modifications and towing equipment in accordance with engineering specifications.
-Align, fit and assemble fabricated components using precision measuring instruments and fabrication techniques.
-Join metal components using MIG, TIG and other appropriate welding processes, together with bolting and riveting where required.
-Inspect fabricated components and welded assemblies to ensure dimensional accuracy, weld quality and compliance with engineering specifications.
-Grind, finish, clean and prepare fabricated products for painting, assembly and final installation.
-Operate fabrication equipment safely while maintaining a clean and organised work environment.
-Work collaboratively with the team, supervisors and production staff to ensure 
-Manufacturing deadlines and quality standards are achieved.

If you are a motivated Metal Fabricator with a strong commitment to quality workmanship and manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Bozmac team.

Software Engineering Discipline Lead - Simulation & Defence Systems | Victoria | Hybrid | Full-time   Your new company     
 Join an Australian engineering firm developing advanced simulation and motion technologies used across the defence sector. The company designs and builds high-fidelity driver training simulators for military vehicles integrating robotics, control systems, and immersive software to replicate real-world driving conditions with precision. 
   Your new role     
 You'll lead a team of 13 software engineers working on complex, real-world systems. Your focus is on: 
   
 
 
 Building a strong, scalable software team 
 
 
 Driving delivery and prioritisation 
 
 
 Lifting engineering discipline, quality, and assurance 
 
 
 Mentoring engineers at different stages of their careers    
 
 
 There is an established Principal Engineer in the structure. You're not expected to be the deepest technical specialist in the room, but you must come from a software engineering background. And be able to guide, challenge, and support engineers credibly. 
 You'll work closely with senior leadership and be the main interface for software delivery, performance, and team health. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 
 A software engineer by background (C++ experience strongly preferred) 
 
 
 Proven experience leading software teams 
 
 
 Comfortable balancing delivery, people leadership, and technical oversight 
 
 
 Able to step in when engineers are stuck and give practical guidance 
 
 
 Experience with Agile environments and tools like Jira 
 
 
 Exposure to safety-critical, regulated, or complex engineering environments is highly regarded. 
 
 
 Australian citizenship (eligibility for Defence Security Clearance required) 
 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 
 A growing engineering organisation with a mix of senior and junior engineers 
 
 
 A business that has tripled in size over the last three years 
 
 
 Clear ambition to expand internationally, with long-term growth opportunities for senior leaders 
 
 
 The chance to shape a team and leave a visible mark, not just maintain the status quo 
 
 
   What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or e-mail directly to lauryn.reddick@hays.com.au    Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
Our valued client, NEWCO FARMS is seeking a dedicated and experienced Animal Husbandry Technician to join their dynamic team. The ideal candidate will provide daily care, including feeding and cleaning, and monitoring the health and behavior of animals in the farm. Key responsibilities involve administering medications, assisting with procedures, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring the animals' living environments are clean and safe, all while adhering to strict specific protocols of Newco Farms.

Work location: Tamworth NSW

Duties include but will not be limited to:
Monitors and maintains the health and welfare of livestock
Assists with breeding and raising livestock
Monitors livestock to evaluate the effectiveness of feed formulae, and assists with the management of livestock nutrition and feeding programs
Provide food, water, and a clean-living environment for animals, which includes cleaning cages and enclosures
Observe animals for any signs of illness or distress, monitor their behavior, and report concerns to veterinary or research staff
Assists in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains
Administer prescribed medications and treatments, and assist veterinarians with medical procedures in strict compliance to Newco Farm’s guidelines including completion of all relevant reports and documentation. Such paperwork to be completed within the required timeframes
Artificially inseminates livestock for breeding purposes, conducts pregnancy tests, manages lactation, and cares for young animals
Collects and collates data for research purposes
Maintain detailed and accurate records of animal care, health, treatments, and procedures performed
Ensure animal housing areas and equipment are clean, sterile, and in good working order
Undertake or reorganise any work procedure as directed by the General Manager and Veterinary Services Manager or as deemed necessary in the absence of a member of staff
Safely handle and restrain animals for procedures, transportation, or other tasks
Ensure strict compliance with the principles of quarantine and biosecurity by all Newco Farm's farming operations
Report workplace hazards identified during the course of work to appropriate person according to standard operating procedures
Assist in the development and maintenance of Safe Work Practises. Support and implement the Company's Accident Prevention Program - support employees/work groups to ensure area is incident/accident free

Skills and knowledge
Proficiency in techniques for safely handling and restraining animals is essential
Ability to interpret animal behavior and a strong understanding of animal welfare principles are crucial
Knowledge of animal health, common diseases, and proper sanitation and hygiene practices is necessary
Organisational skills and familiarity with relevant software for record-keeping are important for maintaining accurate data
Strong communication skills are vital for working effectively with colleagues and supervisors
Technical skills on administering medication, performing basic lab techniques, or using specific farm equipment
Familiarity with regulations governing animal care is required

If you are ready to contribute to a positive and collaborative work environment, and feels this job could be the perfect opportunity for you, please apply now.
Salary: $100,000 per annum

Bowhill Engineering is seeking a motivated and detail-focused Project Assistant to join our team and support the delivery of major infrastructure projects through advanced digital
systems and production support. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of fabrication technology, helping drive a smarter, more connected and paperless workshop environment using industry-leading tools including FabStation and HoloLens AR. Specialising in large government infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill Engineering is powered by technology and driven by great people to optimise and build structures that matter.


About the Role
The Project Assistant plays a key role in strengthening quality, certainty and production flow by embedding advanced digital tools into everyday workshop and project execution. Working closely with Project, Production and Quality teams, you will support digital QA systems, production readiness, reporting and continuous improvement initiatives across the business. Through real-time data, visual verification and disciplined systems, you will help ensure fabrication is built right the first time while reducing rework and improving communication between teams. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys problem solving, technology, organisation and process improvement, while working in a fast-paced fabrication and manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities & Requirements
-Support and maintain digital QA systems including FabStation and HoloLens AR
-Assist with production readiness, work packs and planning coordination
-Ensure real-time production and QA data is accurate and up to date
-Support workshop teams with clear and accessible project information
-Monitor planned versus actual production performance and reporting
-Assist with compliance tracking, reporting and system updates
-Identify opportunities for improvement and help implement smarter processes
-Work collaboratively across Project, Production and Quality teams
-Help strengthen transparency, communication and workflow efficiency across projects
-Support continuous improvement initiatives and maintain OFI registers

Experience & Qualifications
-Current Driver’s Licence (Manual)
-Experience in steel fabrication, construction or manufacturing environments (desirable)
-Strong organisational and time management skills
-Excellent written and verbal communication skills
-Competent IT skills including MS Word, Excel & Outlook
-Experience with production software, Tekla or MS Project (desirable)
-Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
-Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability
-Understanding of WHS requirements and safe work practices

What We Offer
-Opportunity to work on major infrastructure projects of national significance
-Exposure to advanced digital fabrication and QA technology
-Career growth opportunities into a Production Systems Analyst role
-Supportive and collaborative team environment
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)Employee Health Assistance
-Active Social Club and strong workplace culture
-Modern workplace with multiple workshops on site
-Enjoy the River Murray lifestyle
-Join an Employer of Choice in the Murraylands

About Us
Based in Bowhill, South Australia (90 mins from Adelaide, 40 mins from Murray Bridge, 30 mins from Mannum), Bowhill Engineering has built a national reputation for delivering large, complex steel structures with precision and pride — all from one location.
Apply Now - Bring your confidence in new technology & software, your analytical skills, quality focus & ability to capture, interpret & measure production data - we have an immediate spot waiting for you!
Submit your cover letter, resume, and three references via the Bowhill Engineering website.
For more information, contact HR Manager, Samantha Krollig on (08) 8570 4208.
